notes: Three additions. (1) Tonight's Dinner: the Command Center home screen gains a hero banner showing today's entry from the dinner calendar with its recipe photo - tap it and the Cooking view opens with that recipe selected. At 3pm each day the hub also auto-selects tonight's linked recipe so the kitchen panel is ready before you are. (2) Shop this week: on the dinner calendar page, one tap adds every ingredient from the coming week's recipe-linked dinners to the grocery list, skipping anything already on it. (3) Recipe Box + guest accounts: hub.motronimeadows.com/recipes.html is a clean, read-first family cookbook with search and tag filters. A new GUEST permission locks an account to the Recipe Box and recipe editing only - no house data, cameras, chores, lists or calendars - so out-of-house family (hi, Mom!) can browse and save recipes safely. Create the account in Admin and tick GUEST plus Cooking/Recipes.
